test_strategy.item: Never a live model in tests
test_strategy.proven_by: All tests use a fake client object; anthropic.Anthropic patched to raise at module level in test setUp

risks.risk: Gold curation is manual and is the real bottleneck; thin gold rewards precision over recall
risks.mitigation: Start with 18 tasks; radar_gold.py drafts candidates from watchlist sources; track gold size per task in the report

risks.risk: Live web drift makes rollouts non-reproducible across days
risks.mitigation: Closed past windows; the run_dir caches fetched sources and the judge grades against that cache; record the run date with results

risks.risk: Prompt injection from fetched pages steers the agent
risks.mitigation: Narrow tool surface (no bash, no send, writes only to output/); container egress allowlist; delivery from host code only

risks.risk: Price table goes stale, so reported cost is wrong
risks.mitigation: Dated CLAUDE_PRICES constant; Phase 0 verification; cost is labelled an estimate in report output

risks.risk: Improver-edited fetcher scripts attempt off-allowlist egress or heavy work
risks.mitigation: Proxy allowlist + run_script timeout; validate_tree rejects non-stdlib imports in scripts/

risks.risk: Touching core/proposer.py and core/spec.py widens the review surface on a research codebase
risks.mitigation: The changes are additive (new channel value + method); existing five regressions must stay green; channel tests added

rollback: Each phase is its own commit on a feature branch (feat/ai-radar). Revert the phase commits in reverse order; nothing outside the new files changes behavior for existing benchmarks or substrates, and dependencies stays [].
